appState.name: background 60s, link before resume (Android onNewIntent first)
brief pause wraps delivery (app was on screen)

openQueue.name: caps the queue, dropping the oldest

retryDelay.name: eighth failure reaches the 1 h cap
eighth failure, full jitter = the cap
many failures stay at the cap
Retry-After longer than the backoff wins
Retry-After shorter than the backoff: the backoff
Retry-After as an HTTP date is ignored
Retry-After with a fraction is ignored

eventClickId.name: attaches the remembered tap within the window
explicit clickId overrides the remembered tap
explicit clickId with no remembered tap
empty explicit clickId counts as none
tap dated after now (clock moved back)

replyClickId.name: upper-case reply tap id is lower-cased
the reply wins over the known tap id
no reply tap id (older engine): keep the known tap id
no reply tap id and none known: forget
malformed reply tap id falls back to the known one

staleTap.name: attaches the remembered tap within the window
explicit clickId overrides the remembered tap
explicit clickId with no remembered tap
empty explicit clickId counts as none
tap dated after now (clock moved back)

parseHandoffUrl.name: a short link, not a handoff

firstLaunchState.name: app updated from an SDK without installTime: adopt, not a new install
stored empty string counts as never written
storage restored from a backup of another install: run again
install time unknown: the flag alone
first launch, flag empty (cleared by a restore)
first launch after a restore cleared the flag, time not yet written
fraction of a ms is truncated

userId.name: digits with a letter = an id
128 units ending in an emoji (2 units)
129 units ending in an emoji = not sent
BOM before an id is trimmed
BOM before an email is trimmed, then hashed
unit separator at the end = control = not sent
zero-width non-joiner after @ = still an email
email holding a newline = hashed (the @ check first)
bidi marks from a copied contact → +919876543210
a date (8 digits) is hashed too → 20261110
Japanese input: full-width digits and ー → 09012345678
email with a full-width at sign = hashed
email with a small at sign = hashed
not a phone: + after a digit
not a phone: order id with a word
not a phone: tel: and 7 digits
not a phone: all-digit uuid (32 digits)
not a phone: snowflake id (19 digits)
tab between digits = control = not sent
email: i + U+0307 already lower = same hash as İ
email: Σ before @ → σ, not ς
email: Σ before a dot → σ
email: Σ at the very end → σ
email: ς typed in lower case stays ς
email: capital sharp s ẞ → ß
email: Turkish dotless ı stays ı

returnNote.name: day 1 starts exactly 24 h after the install open
day 7 when only day 1 was sent
upper-case tap id is sent lower-case
no sent field = nothing sent yet
sent not an array = nothing sent yet
clock moved back (now before the install): nothing
empty (cleared by opt-out or a new install)
